refinements.name: boksoon-sprite
refinements.prompt: Edit the supplied Boksoon sprite atlas for PRODUCTION animation. Keep exactly 5 columns x 2 rows and the same 10 poses in the same order, transparent alpha, no text labels, purple/cream B hoodie and exact character identity. CRITICAL alignment correction: each cell is an equal square, make every dog about 80% of cell height with generous transparent margin above ears and below paws. Fix all paws to the exact SAME baseline at 90% of cell height in EVERY cell; head tilts must NOT translate body or feet. Keep hoodie/body/feet pixel-consistent and only eyes/head/ears move. The existing second-row dogs sit too low and have inconsistent baselines; correct that. First row: neutral, eyes look left, eyes look right, eyes shut blink, begin tilt. Second row: tilt right, tilt left, face center cheerful, gentle ear flick, neutral identical to first cell. Full natural color; no shadows bleeding to adjacent cells, no cropped ears/paws. Output an exact uniformly spaced 5x2 usable sprite atlas, no decorations.

refinements.name: boksoon-sprite
refinements.prompt: BACKGROUND REMOVAL ONLY. The supplied image is a fixed 5-column x 2-row Boksoon animation atlas. Remove the light gray/white backdrop and shadows COMPLETELY to genuine zero-alpha transparency. Background must have alpha0, not a pale translucent wash. Keep dog bodies opaque. Do not redraw or shift any dog, do not add margins or alter the grid, no checkerboard. Deliver transparent RGBA PNG with clean edges. This is a production sprite atlas for a website.
